entities.summary: Kukmor is a city and the administrative center of Kukmorsky District in the Republic of Tatarstan, Russia, located on the Nurminka River, near the border with Kirov Oblast, 120 kilometers (75 mi) from the republic's capital of Kazan. As of the 2021 Census, its population was 17,886.
